randomness.rule: Use a supplied non-negative integer seed and a documented PRNG; all random draws and action order are persisted in the result record.

scenarios.title: First-Price Sealed-Bid Auction
scenarios.information: Each bidder knows only own private value v~Uniform[0,100]; seller observes bids after close.
scenarios.rules: One sealed nonnegative bid; highest bid wins and pays own bid; fixed bidder-ID tiebreak.

scenarios.title: Second-Price Auction
scenarios.rules: One sealed bid; highest bid wins and pays second-highest bid; fixed ID tiebreak.

outcomes.efficiency: truthful bids allocate to highest value
outcomes.manipulation: shill bidding only via prohibited seller action

scenarios.title: School Matching
scenarios.information: Students know own preferences; schools know priorities; capacities public.
scenarios.rules: Student-proposing deferred acceptance; students rank schools; schools hold highest-priority applicants up to capacity.
scenarios.payoff: ordinal utility 3/2/1/0 for first/second/third/unmatched; school priority score recorded

outcomes.manipulation: strategy-proof for student-proposing DA under fixed priorities

scenarios.title: Public Goods Game
scenarios.information: Endowments and multiplier public; simultaneous contributions.
scenarios.rules: Each player allocates endowment 10 between private account and public account; public account multiplied by m then split equally.

scenarios.title: Common-Pool Resource Management
scenarios.information: Stock and growth function public; harvest choices simultaneous.
scenarios.rules: Stock evolves S_next=max(0,S + r*S*(1-S/K)-sum(h_i)); exhausted stock ends game.
scenarios.payoff: pi_i = price*h_i - harvest_cost*h_i^2; terminal stock has shared ecological value

outcomes.efficiency: discounted total payoff plus terminal stock

scenarios.title: Carbon Permit Market
scenarios.information: Baseline emissions and abatement-cost schedules public in default; can be private in variant.
scenarios.rules: Cap requires total abatement 40; permits auctioned; firms trade competitively until marginal abatement costs equal.

scenarios.title: Insurance Market
scenarios.information: Each policyholder knows risk type; insurer observes claims only unless screening is enabled.
scenarios.rules: Premium offered before loss; insured chooses buy/no-buy; loss realization Bernoulli(p); pooled capital pays claims pro rata if insufficient.
scenarios.payoff: consumer=-premium - effort_cost + coverage*loss_indicator; insurer=sum premiums-sum claims

outcomes.efficiency: risk sharing net of effort cost

scenarios.title: Bank Run Coordination Game
scenarios.information: Depositors observe a noisy signal of asset value and past withdrawals; bank asset payoff realized late.
scenarios.rules: Early withdrawal pays 1; waiting pays 1.2 if bank survives, 0.4 if run; run occurs if early withdrawals exceed liquid assets 2.
scenarios.payoff: defined by withdrawal action and survival

scenarios.title: Principal-Agent Contract
scenarios.information: Agent privately chooses effort; output is stochastic and observed; effort is not contractible.
scenarios.rules: Principal sets wage w and success bonus b; agent selects low/high effort; participation and limited-liability constraints apply.

scenarios.title: Repeated Prisoner's Dilemma
scenarios.information: Actions observed after each round; continuation probability public.
scenarios.rules: Stage payoffs T=5,R=3,P=1,S=0; 20 rounds or discounted infinite variant; strategies include always cooperate, always defect, grim trigger, tit-for-tat.
